d: Some careers grow faster than others.
If you’re looking for further opportunities to develop your career, take the next step in fulfilling your potential right here at HSBC.

We’re looking for an ambitious professional to join the Global Network Banking UAE team as an Associate Relationship Manager (ARM). This role will support business growth and contribute to achieving divisional targets while managing relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including Sales, Product Development, Risk and Compliance teams.

Working closely with the UAE Client Coverage team, the ARM will be responsible for delivering high standards across client service, risk management, sales and operational activities. The role may cover a specific area within the UAE or span multiple countries, with a focus on managing the pipeline, driving sales activity and delivering excellent customer experience.
q: A full-time graduation degree of at least three years is essential for obtaining a UAE visa and work permit. For degrees obtained outside the UAE, valid attestations and equivalency are also mandatory.
Demonstrated experience and a strong track record in risk management, operations, regulatory matters, credit analysis and judgement-based lending.
Strong spoken and written English communication skills.
In-depth knowledge of the Commercial Banking market, both globally and within the local market, includes the competitive landscape and competitor propositions.
Well-developed analytical skills, with a strong focus on credit and operational risk.
Proven ability to lead visibly, motivate others and influence stakeholders.
Excellent interpersonal and relationship management skills, with the ability to inspire, influence and negotiate effectively with customers and colleagues.
Strong planning and organizational capabilities, combined with the resilience and determination to deliver results.
Innovative and solutions-focused, with a practical approach to problem-solving.
For further details and application information please visit our careers site, searching for reference number 62471.
We support our staff to adopt flexible and alternative ways of working where possible, including working from home and different hours subject to approvals.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. d: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.

We are looking for an Investigation Analyst to join our Screening Escalations & Geofencing team on a 12-month contract. You will investigate suspicious login activities, review risk alerts, and support timely, evidence-based decisions to strengthen platform security and risk controls.
q: Experience in investigations, fraud, financial crime, compliance, or risk operations.
Strong analytical skills, investigative thinking, and attention to detail.
Good judgment and the ability to assess cases using multiple information sources.
Strong English communication and documentation skills.
Ability to manage case volumes in a fast-paced environment.
Experience in fintech, e-commerce, banking, payments, or digital assets.
Familiarity with IP analysis, geolocation, or suspicious account or user activity.
Experience with case management or investigation tools.
Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy
Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
